name: Researching the Corruption
summary: In Auberdine, Gershala Nightwhisper seeks corrupted brain stems from Blackfathom Deeps. Reports say blood elves across the sea are turning to demonic magic, and he hopes to learn from the naga and satyr before history repeats itself.

sections.title: A Warning from History
sections.body: The ruin of their ancient kin remains a living memory to night elves across Kalimdor. Ten thousand years ago, the Highborne gave in to demonic energies and became horned satyrs or serpentine naga. Now the high elves call themselves blood elves and embrace dark magic. Gershala Nightwhisper sees the old disaster taking shape again.

sections.title: Into the Deeps
sections.body: Blackfathom Deeps offers Gershala a place to study the corruption. The temple ruins lie beneath the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale, where satyr cultists and naga dwell. He asks you to gather brain stems from both, hoping to trace the link between arcane addiction, demonic corruption, and the ruin of the body.

sections.title: A Desperate Cure
sections.body: Gershala says he studies the body to find a way to prevent another fall. He believes the shared mutations of satyrs and naga may show how to draw the blood elves back from damnation. Can research in Darkshore sway the desperate elves of Quel'Thalas? That remains uncertain.

faq.q: Why does Gershala Nightwhisper care about the blood elves?
faq.answer: Gershala fears the blood elves' turn to demonic powers could create another race of twisted monsters, as elven hubris once gave rise to satyrs and naga.

faq.q: Where do you gather the corrupted brain stems?
faq.answer: Gather the brain stems from satyrs and naga in Blackfathom Deeps, an ancient temple complex beneath the Zoram Strand on Ashenvale's northwest coast.

faq.q: Why does he specifically want satyr and naga samples?
faq.answer: Satyrs and naga both began as elves warped by unnatural forces: satyrs through demonic bargains, and naga through the Sundering. Gershala compares their brain mutations to learn how dark power harms elven bodies.

faq.q: Who leads you to this task?
faq.answer: An introductory trail called The Corruption Abroad can lead you to Gershala Nightwhisper in Auberdine. He can also offer the investigation directly.

faq.q: What does Gershala plan to do with the specimens?
faq.answer: Gershala plans to compare the bodily effects of the two corruptions, hoping what he learns can slow the blood elves' descent into monstrosity.

faq.q: Is Auberdine directly threatened by Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: Blackfathom Deeps lies just across Ashenvale's southern border. The night elves of Auberdine watch the coast for signs of worsening demonic and Twilight corruption.

angles.text: As a night elf, you face a wound still alive in your people's memory: your kin became the satyrs and naga who plague Kalimdor.
As a druid, you feel revulsion toward satyrs, whose fel corruption defiles the natural dream and warps the land.
As a mage, you see the bodily and spiritual cost of reckless dependence on magic.
As an Alliance member, you hear reports of blood elves turning to dark arts across the sea and fear a new demonic threat.
